title: A required test fails when a theme leaves a role unstyled or breaks the token contract, with a baseline that only shrinks

source.ref: Theme cohesion sweep (docs/THEME-COHESION.md, ADR-1923). Owner picks 2026-10-29: role blocks and manifest, phased; no live site changes on its own.

detail:
Vitest sibling in VITEST_ENFORCED, like design-system.test.ts. Nightly pixel run for overflow. Wired in the same PR as its first green run.

Shipped: scripts/theme-conformance.test.ts (in VITEST_ENFORCED as check:theme-conformance, local command scripts/theme-conformance.mjs). For each of the nine manifests, every role and layout: all 45 core names mapped, every token a role sheet reads valued, the sheet holds no raw colour, private token, literal font or non-contract var, every layout renders with its hooks, every emitted part is declared and styled. scripts/theme-conformance-baseline.json (empty today) only shrinks: a fresh gap fails and a healed one fails until deleted. Not shipped: the nightly pixel overflow run (needs a built site and a Playwright job, not cheap); presentation-layer and manifest role-level rules join with LIVE-1861 and the manifest roles field. Baseline seeded with one gap: theme-no-map:free-human (Free Human has no core token mapping yet); it leaves the baseline when that theme joins the contract.

verify.note: Reads the wiring this row ships; fails on main. The behaviour is pinned by the row's own tests.
